notes: The abstract glosses the full chemical name with the trivial name in brackets, (Tembotrione), so resolution is supported inside the section. This section prints the chemical name with a space before cyclohexan-1,3-dion, unlike the rest of the document, and the alias is carried exactly as printed here rather than in the unbroken form used elsewhere. Called herbizider Wirkstoff, herbicidal active ingredient, which is the compound_class tag. role is other because the abstract describes the crystal form, not a synthesis.

The abstract is about this modification: it is described as thermodynamisch stabile Kristallmodifikation, without a numeral, which [0009] and [0010] of the same document fix as modification I. Same molecule as tembotrione, C17H16ClF3O6S: identical atoms and bonds, differing only in the crystal lattice. It is crystal modification I and is not a distinct chemical entity. The stated advantage in the stability of suspension formulations is a property of the formulation, not a characterisation value, so no analytics entry is made. Aliases here carry only the spellings this section itself prints. The other spellings this document uses for it sit on the records of the sections that print them, and finalise.py unions them.
